messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Building Renjin
parts:
Per, 
I think I managed to fix it in this branch:
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/pull/438

The compiler problems seem to arise from using a 32-bit VM versus a 64-bit VM. I think GCC produces slightly different output under a 32-bit system and our GCC-bridge doesn't handle it correctly. So i just swapped out the vagrant box with a 64-bit VM and everything works again.

Alex

Per, 
I think I managed to fix it in this branch:

Alex
